requirements.requirement: The system must successfully execute an end-to-end integration test where a provider evaluation request flows through the EvaluateCare facade, scoring engine, and API layer, returning a response with a composite score.
The system must verify that the composite provider score is present in the API response payload for a valid provider evaluation request.
The system must verify that the composite score value matches the deterministic output of the scoring engine for the same input dataset.
The system must confirm that at least three component quality measures are included in the response alongside the composite score.
The system must validate that the EvaluateCare facade invokes the scoring engine exactly once per provider evaluation request.
The system must verify that the API response structure conforms to the updated FastAPI response model including scoring fields.
The system must confirm that identical input requests produce identical composite scores across multiple integration test runs.
The system must validate that the tool_router integration path correctly propagates scoring data from the facade to the final API response.
The system must return a valid API response with a null or omitted composite score when fewer than three quality measures are available.
The system must return an error response or handled failure when the scoring engine raises an exception during processing.
The system must verify that no scoring-related fields are present in the API response when scoring is not triggered for a request.
The system must ensure that integration tests execute within the existing pytest framework and follow established patterns from test_tool_router.py.
